context: A barista vents to her friend about her part-time wage situation
purpose: Teach: 支給/引き上げ/就業/収支/不十分/金銭/増し/マネージャー

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ねえ聞いて、うちのカフェの給料日、また遅れてさ、給与支給のシステムがもうグダグダなんだよ。
lines.en: Hey listen, our cafe's payday got delayed again — the wage payout system is a total mess.
lines.style: Frustrated venting, slightly raised voice, casual girl-talk tone with bite.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: えー、ひどいね。時給アップも全然ないの？最低賃金の引き上げの話とか出てないの？
lines.en: Whaat, that's awful. No hourly raise either? Hasn't a minimum-wage hike come up?
lines.style: Soft sympathetic tone, gentle concern, dreamy slow pace with curiosity.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: それがゼロなの。就業時間は長いのに、毎月の収支が全然合わなくて、貯金も完全に不十分でさ。
lines.en: Zero. My work hours are long but my monthly budget never balances, and my savings are totally insufficient.
lines.style: Tired exasperated rant, fast frustrated delivery, sighing throughout.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 金銭的にきついよね…深夜手当とか、ちょっとは増しになる時間帯ないの？
lines.en: Financially that's rough… isn't there a late-night allowance or any shift that pays a bit more?
lines.style: Caring soft-spoken question, slow empathetic warmth, quiet gentle concern.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: それがさ、新しい店舗マネージャーがケチで、ボーナスもカットされそうな勢いなんだよ、もう。
lines.en: So our new store manager is stingy, even our bonus looks like it'll get cut, ugh.
lines.style: Annoyed venting, mocking eye-roll edge, exasperated huff at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ええ、最悪じゃん。アオイ、家計簿ちゃんとつけてる？私も一緒に見て、節約一緒に考えようよ。
lines.en: Whaaat, that's the worst. Aoi, are you keeping a budget book? Let's look together and figure out savings.
lines.style: Warm caring offer, gentle nurturing tone, slow reassuring sisterly pace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ありがと…正直さ、来月の家賃も払えるか分からないレベルで、ほんとに崖っぷちなんだよね。
lines.en: Thanks… honestly, I don't even know if I can pay next month's rent — I'm really on the edge.
lines.style: Vulnerable quiet admission, voice trailing off softly, near-tearful fragility.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: じゃあ一回マネージャーに、ちゃんと昇給の相談してみなよ。応援するからさ、絶対大丈夫だよ。
lines.en: Then try properly talking to the manager about a raise. I'm rooting for you, you'll be okay.
lines.style: Encouraging gentle push, warm supportive tone, hopeful softness rising at end.
